meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Astropy 库编写和调试天文数据分析代码,涵盖单位换算、坐标转换、FITS 文件、表格、时间、宇宙学、WCS 等;涉及细节时查阅附带的参考文件。要求 Python 3.11+ 并已安装 astropy。
howto.when: 当用户要求实现或调试使用 Astropy 的天文数据分析代码时触发,例如涉及单位转换、坐标转换或 FITS 文件等任务。

say.text: 用 Astropy 把 ICRS 坐标 (10.5, 41.2) 转成银道坐标。
读取 observation.fits 的图像数据和曝光时间头关键字。
say.note: 用 fits.open 并打印结构。

say.text: 用 Planck18 计算红移 1.5 的光度距离和回溯时间。

howto.what_en: Claude will write and debug astronomical data analysis code using the Astropy library, covering unit conversions, coordinate transformations, FITS files, tables, time, cosmology, WCS, and more. It consults bundled reference files for details. Requires Python 3.11+ with astropy installed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement or debug astronomical data analysis code using Astropy, e.g., tasks involving unit conversion, coordinate transformation, or FITS files.

say_en.text: Convert ICRS coordinates (10.5, 41.2) to Galactic using Astropy.
Read image data and EXPTIME header keyword from observation.fits.
Compute luminosity distance and lookback time at z=1.5 with Planck18.
